catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-1.explanation: CMan: Did you see that article in the paper saying that the Oxford English Dictionary may never again be published as a set of books?

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-2.explanation: BWoman: But now, at last, we’re able to have it in a much more beautiful and accessible form and don’t have to put up with old inconveniences like books any more. And I’d go along with that.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-3.explanation: BMan: But the worst thing was when I came to leave. The street turned out to be a dead end. There wasn’t enough room for a car the size of ours to turn, so I had to back all the way out.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-4.explanation: CWoman: Well, good for you, I hate having to reverse like that.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-5.explanation: CMan: You wanted to see me?Woman: Yes, it was just to talk about that report you did for me.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-6.explanation: AMan: Oh, right. Anything major?Woman: Well, you’re going to have to go away and study the fine print pretty thoroughly.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-7.explanation: lawyerI had a good job as a lawyer and the company I was employed by had just been taken over.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-8.explanation: fluI lost my job in August. I’d just been off sick with flu.[...] Then, on my first day back at work, I found I didn’t have a job any more.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-9.explanation: Central AmericaThen within a week I’d booked a flight to Central America and spent a month travelling there.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-10.explanation: skiingI’d recently been skiing for the first time and I really enjoyed it but had thought to myself that I’d never be able to get that good if I only did it once a year. So, it seemed like the perfect opportunity to spend more time in the mountains.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-11.explanation: sunrise(s)... when I had to get up at 6 am and saw the sunrise, it was all worth it.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-12.explanation: ordinaryI liked my life before, but I appreciate now that it was very ordinary, and there’s an awful lot more out there.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-13.explanation: panicWell, the first thing I’d say is to welcome it, and above all, don’t panic.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-14.explanation: gratitudeMy main feeling now towards the people who fired me is, honestly, one of gratitude.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-15.explanation: CBella:[...] Anyway, I found it particularly interesting to read about a spacewoman. There aren’t too many of those around. Tom: You’re right there!

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-16.explanation: ABella: What I liked best were the sections which quoted her — I thought she was amazingly good at conveying what it was like to go into space.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-17.explanation: BBella: But I never imagined that you needed to have a post-graduate degree. I don’t think I even realised you had to be a graduate.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-18.explanation: BBella: Yes, it must. But I particularly was intrigued by her account of the role she sometimes has as one of the people on earth who are in control of the mission.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-19.explanation: ATom: Yes, it was. Thought I thought it was a pity it didn’t tell us as much as it might have done about the less pleasant sides of being in space.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-20.explanation: DTom: [...] But what I do fancy doing is going to a series of lectures I’ve seen advertised on astronauts and how they’re portrayed in the cinema and in books.Bella: Wow! That sounds brilliant! Do you mind if I come along too?

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-21.explanation: HYou don’t expect to find somewhere so nice in a place below the ground floor of a big house.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-22.explanation: D... and when some people from the sports club I’d joined invited me to share with them, I jumped at the chance to escape the noise!

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-24.explanation: GIn fact, it’s a flat that belongs to my workplace and they rent it out at a very reduced rates to member of staff.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-25.explanation: AI had dinner with him one night and he persuaded me to get the one moored next to his which was for sale. It’s tiny but I love it.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-26.explanation: GIt just had so much room.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-27.explanation: CYou’d be amazed at how peaceful it is there.

catalog-listening-cae-c1-test27-q-28.explanation: FMost of the flats that were being advertised turned out to be already taken when I called, but in the end I found one.
